Aggregate flowpath network topology without divide geometry

Source: R/aggregate_network_and_divides.R
aggregate_network.Rd

Flowpath-only replacement for the aggregate-to-distribution step. Runs mainstem aggregation and headwater collapse using purely graph/tabular operations, no union_polygons, terra::makeValid, st_snap, or terra::relate. Returns aggregated flowpaths, network table, and poi layer.

The returned divides element is a geometry-free stub (data.frame) carrying only divide_id and flowpath_toid. Pass it with rec_div to construct_agg_divides() to build real divide geometry.

Usage

aggregate_network(
  flowpath,
  divide,
  pois = NULL,
  vpu = NULL,
  max_junction = 2,
  ideal_size_sqkm = 10,
  min_area_sqkm = 3,
  max_area_sqkm = 15,
  min_length_km = 0.25,
  connector_ids = NULL
)

Arguments

flowpath

Reconciled flowpath sf from Stage-1 rec_fp_agg.

divide

Reconciled divide sf from Stage-1 rec_div. Used only by prepare_network() for initial topology setup.

pois

POI sf from the refactor phase.

vpu

VPU identifier written to network table.

max_junction, ideal_size_sqkm, min_area_sqkm, max_area_sqkm, min_length_km

Aggregation parameters.

connector_ids

Optional character vector of catchment-less connector reach ids (e.g. divide-less reaches over waterbodies). Such reaches are held out of the small-catchment collapse/absorb steps so they are preserved rather than merged away. NULL (default) treats none as connectors.

Value

Named list: flowpaths (sf), divides (stub data.frame), network (data.frame), pois (sf or NULL).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
s1_fp   <- sf::st_read("rec_fp_agg.gpkg", "flowpaths")
rec_div <- sf::st_read("rec_div.gpkg", "divides")
pois    <- sf::st_read("pois.gpkg", "pois")
agg <- aggregate_network(flowpath = s1_fp, divide = rec_div,
                         pois = pois, vpu = "01")
} # }
